notes:
{自制|じせい} means controlling oneself, particularly one's emotions, desires, or impulses.

WRITING:
- {自|じ} (self)
- ⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (control, regulate)

USAGE:
- {自制|じせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exercise self-control - suru verb)
- ⟦{自制心|じせいしん}→自制心：18252_jiseishin⟧ (self-control, willpower - noun)
- {自制|じせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to lose self-control)
- {自制|じせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (to have self-control working)
- More internal/psychological than ⟦{抑制|よくせい}→抑制：05635_yokusei⟧ (restraint)
- Implies conscious effort and willpower
- Can refer to controlling emotions, appetite, spending, etc.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {自制|じせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧ (to maintain self-control)
- {自制|じせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧ (to urge self-restraint)
- {自制|じせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効|き}いた→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (self-controlled, composed)

- ⟦{忍耐|にんたい}→忍耐：05212_nintai⟧ (patience, endurance)
